bio: This place boasts a fantastic location right next to the rugged and dramatic Saas-Fee gorge, through which the Feeru Vispa glacial stream flows. Hotel La Gorge offers comfortable, modern accommodation and a delightful dining experience at its restaurant, Zer Schlucht, serving regional and seasonal cuisine in a charming Alpine setting. The mouthwatering options on the menu include classics such as ossobuco, specialties such as Thurgau apple-pomace fed pork with apricot, chanterelles, rosemary and spaetzle, as well as vegan dishes such as gnocchi, mushrooms, chard and pine nuts. Request a table by the floor-to-ceiling windows for stunning views of the gorge and forest. Shorter menu available at lunchtime....
